image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays its characteristic fan-like pectoral fins and elongated dorsal spines. The body features dark vertical bands with lighter spots, set against a background of greenish corals and rocky substrate.
